what: While the handheld phone stands sticky at screen center, the side text lines change one at a time in each slot of a long panel (original 500vh) divided into (line count + 1) slots. A text line fades from 0 to 1 while rising from 15% of its own height below to 0 in the first 1/4 of the slot, and fades out while rising to −15% in the last 1/4 (straight line). The video or image on the phone screen switches right at the same slot. A video screen plays when its slot is entered and pauses when it is left

options.rise: Distance the line text rises (% of its own height), default 15
options.edge: Portion of time used for cell appear/disappear, default .25
options.[data-fx-part=list]: Long track that measures the cells (the taller it is, the longer the cells) — required
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Line text (several, stacked inside the sticky panel) — required
options.[data-fx-part=screen]: Phone screens (several, overlapped) — if video, it plays in that slot
options.[data-fx-part=phone]: If set, the Hero becomes visible once this element enters from the bottom of the screen
options.[data-fx-part=end]: If set, the end screen stays visible until the top edge of this element touches the top of the screen
